deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/infra-optimizations v2026.03.17 :rocket:
ops_oncall: seeing a sharp throughput drop on eu-west-1 shard-12, lots of worker restarts, throwing OOMs
ops_oncall: logs: 
```
[2026-03-17T14:02:12Z] worker-42 ERROR: cuda out of memory allocating 1.2GiB
[2026-03-17T14:02:13Z] worker-42 INFO: restarting worker (OOM)
[2026-03-17T14:02:15Z] worker-43 INFO: started, kv_cache miss-rate spike
```
devon_runtime: hmm, can we confirm kernel selection changed in this deploy? I pushed a heuristic tweak to prefer fast-f32 kernels for short seqs
marie_infra: metrics show slab_free_pages dropping to near zero right before restarts, sweep-rate isn't keeping up
sam_ml: profiling snapshot (short): kernel_selector.runs=+67% f32_fast chosen for seq<64, avg_alloc_per_req +18%
jen_ops: noisy tenant detected: tenant-id noisy-12 had 3x concurrent small requests at 14:01:40..14:03:00
observability-bot: KV cache evict_rate: baseline 0.4/s -> spike 3.6/s, prefix_cache.hit_rate down 12%
ops_oncall: batching heuristics also show small_batch_ratio up from 22% -> 48% (sudden traffic pattern)
devon_runtime: that combo is dangerous: fast-f32 kernel uses slightly larger temporary buffers for continuous batching, plus small batches decrease amortization -> more allocations
marie_infra: looks like page fragmentation pattern: freed pages are too small -> allocator can't satisfy 1.2GiB contiguous -> OOM even though total free mem reported 5GiB
sam_ml: so not pure noisy tenant memory hog; it's fragmentation resonance after kernel switch + small-batch surge
jen_ops: first action: pause rollout on other regions and roll back kernel_selector tweak on canary nodes? :thinking_face:
devon_runtime: agree. Revert kernel heuristic on canary pool immediately. Patch is trivial: set prefer_f32_for_short=false
ops_oncall: rolling back canary now. Running drain on 3 affected hosts and rebooting worker processes to recompact allocator
jen_ops: commands I ran: 
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/worker-pool-canary --to-revision=2026.03.14
for n in host5 host7 host9; do ssh $n 'systemctl restart worker'; done
```
observability-bot: after rollback: evict_rate down to 0.6/s, slab_free_pages recovering, worker restarts dropped to 0 in last 60s
ops_oncall: throughput back up to 86% of baseline, latency P95 improved from 540ms -> 220ms
devon_runtime: still want a follow-up: need allocator tuning and a guardrail in kernel selector for fragmentation-prone combos
sam_ml: also update batching heuristic to detect small-batch surges and temporarily increase batch_timeout to coalesce more requests
marie_infra: I'll add a background compaction sweep and increase sweep target by 20% for the next rollout window
jen_ops: filing incident ticket and action items
jen_ops: incident-2091234567 created: https://redwood.internal/incident/2091234567 :spiral_notepad:
